metadata.dc:title: London Airbnb Spatial Analysis: Investigating Structural and Economic Segmentation
metadata.dc:creator: Diya Gajjar
metadata.dc:subject: Spatial Data Science; Geographically Weighted Regression (GWR); Market Segmentation; K-Means Clustering; t-SNE
metadata.dc:description: A geospatial data science pipeline analyzing London's short-term rental market. The project shifts from a global OLS baseline to a local Geographically Weighted Regression (GWR) to model spatial non-stationarity and map commercial market divides.
metadata.dc:coverage: United Kingdom; London; Greater London Borough Boundaries
